metadata.title: चूहों ने मार दी दो बच्ची, अस्पताल सोता रहा | JAYS Protest After Rat Bite Tragedy in Indore
metadata.description: A shocking incident has rocked Indore after two newborn babies lost their lives due to rat bites inside a government hospital. What makes the tragedy even more disturbing is that one of the victims belonged to a tribal family. Instead of taking responsibility, the hospital administration allegedly tried to mislead both the media and the grieving parents by declaring the tribal baby as an orphan. Outraged by this attempt to cover up the truth, the tribal organization JAYs has launched a continuous protest outside the hospital. They are demanding strict action against senior officials responsible for this gross negligence, along with proper compensation for the affected family. The incident has once again raised serious questions about the safety, accountability, and discriminatory treatment of tribal patients in public health institutions.
